title: Automated Summarization of Financial News Using Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation: An Early Empirical Study (Fall 2023)
abstract: arXiv:2608.19526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stock market analysts and investors face a daily challenge: too much financial news, too little time. Manually reading and synthesizing hundreds of company-specific articles is impractical, yet missing key information can directly affect investment decisions. This project, conducted at George Washington University in Fall 2023, explores whether Large Language Models can automate this process reliably. We built a pipeline that pulls news articles from the News API, company background from Wikipedia, and stock price data from Yahoo Finance for ten major companies (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, JPM, NVDA, WMT, DIS). Because LLMs cannot directly process numerical tables, we developed a simple but effective template that converts stock data into natural language narratives. translated_title: 利用大型语言模型与检索增强生成技术自动化金融新闻摘要：一项初步实证研究（2023年秋季）
translated_abstract: 股票市场分析师和投资者每天面临一个挑战：金融新闻太多，时间太少。手动阅读和综合数百篇公司特定文章是不切实际的，但错过关键信息可能直接影响投资决策。本项目于2023年秋季在乔治华盛顿大学开展，探讨大型语言模型能否可靠地自动化这一过程。我们构建了一个流程，从News API获取新闻文章，从Wikipedia获取公司背景，从Yahoo Finance获取十家主要公司（AAPL、MSFT、GOOGL、AMZN、META、TSLA、JPM、NVDA、WMT、DIS）的股价数据。由于LLM无法直接处理数值表格，我们开发了一种简单但有效的模板，将股票数据转换为自然语言叙述。随后，我们测试了两种摘要方法（Summarize Chains和基于FAISS的检索增强生成），使用了三种开源模型（Falcon-7B-Instruct、...），并进行了初步实证比较。
tldr: 本研究构建了一个自动化金融新闻摘要流程，通过将股票数据转换为自然语言，并比较不同摘要方法，证明了大型语言模型在金融信息处理中的可行性。
en_tdlr: This study builds an automated financial news summarization pipeline, converts stock data into natural language, and compares different summarization approaches, demonstrating the feasibility of large language models in financial information processing.
